message.reasoning_content:
The user asks: "Compute 23 * 19 - 17. Reply with the integer only."

We need to compute 23 * 19 - 17.

23 * 19 = 23 * (20 - 1) = 23*20 - 23 = 460 - 23 = 437.

Then subtract 17: 437 - 17 = 420.

Thus answer is 420.

We must reply with integer only, no extra text. So just "420".
